text.source: Results: parish returns as published by NBC News (from the Associated Press) on Nov 7, 2026, with about 99% of the expected vote counted statewide. Counts are unofficial until certified. Swing compares with the official 2024 presidential parish results (two-party share), because Louisiana's recent Senate races were open multi-candidate primaries with no clean two-way comparison. Residents: Census Bureau July 1, 2025 parish estimates (Vintage 2025, table co-est2025-pop-22).
